images.caption: DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY, Fla. -- The military-sponsored NASCAR cars line up on the speedway, ready to kick off the 2004 Nextel Cup season here Feb. 15.  Ricky Rudd (far right) will be driving the Air Force-sponsored Wood Brothers Racing #21 car.  The other service's drivers are (from left) Greg Biffle for the National Guard; Bobby Hamilton Jr. for the Marines; Casey Atwood for the Navy; Joe Nemechek for the Army; and Justin Labonte for the Coast Guard.  Standing with the drivers are representatives from each service.  (U.S. Air Force photo by Larry McTighe)
images.alt: DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY, Fla. -- The military-sponsored NASCAR cars line up on the speedway, ready to kick off the 2004 Nextel Cup season here Feb. 15.  Ricky Rudd (far right) will be driving the Air Force-sponsored Wood Brothers Racing #21 car.  The other service's drivers are (from left) Greg Biffle for the National Guard; Bobby Hamilton Jr. for the Marines; Casey Atwood for the Navy; Joe Nemechek for the Army; and Justin Labonte for the Coast Guard.  Standing with the drivers are representatives from each service.  (U.S. Air Force photo by Larry McTighe)

images.caption: Sergeant Major of the Army Kenneth Preston address the crowd of more than 180,000 before the start of the Daytona 500 Sunday at Daytona International Speedway. He praised the Soldiers deployed around the world and asked NASCAR fans to remember them. The Army car, driven by Joe Nemechek, finished in 6th place. U.S. Army photo by Master Sgt. Rich Puckett.
